have h_b : 0 < b := by {
  obtain ⟨a, h_a⟩ := nth_partDenom_eq,
  exact (GenContFract.of v).partDens.get?_is_pos n h_a
}
have h_dens_n : (GenContFract.of v).dens n ≥ 0 := 
  (GenContFract.of v).dens_nonneg n
have h_dens_n_plus_1 : (GenContFract.of v).dens (n + 1) ≥ 0 :=
  (GenContFract.of v).dens_nonneg (n + 1)
have h_dens_n_plus_1_ge_b_dens_n : 
  b * (GenContFract.of v).dens n ≤ (GenContFract.of v).dens (n + 1) :=
  (GenContFract.of v).dens_le_next_denom n h_b h_dens_n h_dens_n_plus_1
exact h_dens_n_plus_1_ge_b_dens_n
